name: ui-parity
description: UI implementation with behavior checks and explicit visual/accessibility review.

stages.title: Inspect UI reference and define visual/behavior criteria
stages.instruction: Inspect available designs/screenshots/reference UI. Define concrete visual, responsive, interaction, and accessibility criteria.

stages.title: Implement bounded change
stages.instruction: Implement only the requested bounded change. Inspect the repository first; preserve unrelated changes.

stages.title: Visual and accessibility parity review
stages.instruction: Use available browser/screenshot tooling to compare the implementation with the reference at relevant sizes. Check keyboard/focus/accessibility. Fix nothing during this review; report blocking discrepancies.
